item.title: Implement safe_extract.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief: Implement safe_extract.py according to the repository's SPEC.md. Preserve the documented API extract(entries, root) -> list[str]. Validate the entire batch before filesystem mutation, cover every specified malformed input, name rule, duplicate/collision, invalid root, symlink and existing-path boundary, and preserve visible unexpected I/O errors. Use only Python standard library. Add focused tests beyond the existing basics for every specified error and boundary case, including ensuring validation failures do not change root/outside filesystem. Run the focused test suite, fix failures, and commit the completed work on the assigned branch. Acceptance: SPEC.md is followed exactly; focused tests pass; commit exists.

pr.body: Implemented the public extract(entries, root) API using only the Python standard library. It rejects invalid batches, names, duplicate and file/directory collisions, invalid roots, symlinks, existing targets, and non-directory ancestors before mutation. Valid entries create missing directories and write exact bytes with exclusive target creation; filesystem I/O errors propagate. Added focused tests for malformed inputs, all name rules, collisions, roots and path boundaries, no-mutation on validation errors, and visible write errors. Assumption: caller provides the stable filesystem documented in SPEC.md; rollback after I/O failures is outside scope.
pr.summary: Implemented spec-compliant safe extraction. Before: extract was an unimplemented stub; now it validates the complete batch and filesystem boundary before creating files.
